description: Recent Time Series (up to 30k bars). Retrieve recent historical OHLCV data for a symbol with configurable time intervals and adjustments. Option contracts (`OPRA:` codes) support tick series (the latest trades, up to 30,000; `bar_interval` is ignored) and minute (1–59, or whole hours up to 23), hour (1–24), day (1 or 7), week (1) and month (1, 2, 3, 4, 6 or 12) bars; second bars and other intervals answer `not_supported`. → Returns {code: string, bar_type: string, bar_end?: number, last_update: number, series: [{time: number, open?: number, high?: number, low?: number, close: number, volume?: number, type?: string}]}. With abbr=true: {code: string, bar_type: string, bar_end?: number, last_update: number, series_keys: string[], series: number[][]} — compact arrays for reduced LLM token usage. Not all bar types include the same fields (e.g., tick data may only have [time, type, close]) — always check series_keys. Tick points may also include us (Unix microseconds), trade_id, trade_exchange, tape, and trade_conditions when available. For intra-day historical data (if you need more than recent 30k bars) use get_symbol_history instead. For real-time streaming, read the insightsentry://docs/ws resource.

24h.description: (Optional) Request 24-hour market data. Only NYSE, NASDAQ, AMEX, and CBOE are supported; other exchanges ignore this parameter. When true, takes precedence over extended. Default is false.

abbr.description: Set to true to return series as arrays with a series_keys array of field names. Empty series may omit series_keys.

badj.description: (Optional) Back-adjustment for continous futures contracts (has no effect on non-continous futures data). Default to true.

bar_interval.description: Bar interval. Default is 1; tick and second bars use 1, as do unsupported values.

dadj.description: (Optional) Dividend adjustment for equities and etfs (has no effect on assets without dividends). Ignored when split=false. Default to false.

dp.description: The minimum value of 1 is preserved; values from 2 are rounded up to the next multiple of 500 data points. Default is 3000. Supported values: 1 - 30000.

extended.description: (Optional) Extended hours (Not all assets support extended hours). Default to true.

filter.description: (Optional) JSONata expression to return only the fields or rows you need. See https://jsonata.org for syntax.

output_dir.description: Directory for stored response when output_file is not set.

settlement.description: (Optional) Set Settlement as daily close. Default is false

split.description: (Optional) Split adjustment for equities and ETFs. Default to true. When false, returns unadjusted data and overrides dadj.

store.description: Store the response locally instead of returning it. Default is none. csv is only supported for get_symbol_series.

symbol.description: Symbol in Exchange:Symbol format (e.g., NASDAQ:AAPL, NYSE:TSLA). You can search for this symbol code using the /v3/symbols/search endpoint.

name: get_symbol_series
